svg.title: Message cleanup and tidy-specific tags
svg.desc: Check-name suffix removal and tidy tag assignment move into finalizeDiagnostic(), once notes and fixes are available. The same cleanup is applied to the diagnostic, its notes and its fixes. Added containment checks prevent adding a tag that another module already supplied.
svg.text: Check-name suffix removal and tidy tag assignment move into finalizeDiagnostic(), once notes and fixes are available.
The same cleanup is applied to the diagnostic, its notes and its fixes.
Added containment checks prevent adding a tag that another module already supplied.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
